`functional-env.fasta` contains the reference and three ungapped, trimmed passing
coding sequences (variants 1, 9, and 45) from donor_1_REN in the public nanopore
demo: https://github.com/MurrellGroup/PORPIDpipeline/blob/nanopore/raw-reads/demo.fastq.gz.
It covers a full-length Env and shorter ORFs, including divergent N termini, for
MAFFT sequence preservation, profile preservation, and terminal-stop regression
checks. Headers are shortened to keep the fixture independent of display labels.
